item.title: Once Trump’s Co-Pilot Against Iran, Netanyahu Is Now a Mere Passenger
item.description: A partner in the war, Israel has been largely left out of the peace talks, a humbling setback for its prime minister with significant risks for the country.

item.title: Middle East war live: US and Iran are ‘getting a lot closer’ to finalising agreement, Trump says
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Saturday told US broadcaster CBS that Tehran and Washington were "getting a lot closer" to finalising an agreement between the two countries. Iran earlier said that it was in the “final stage” of drafting an agreement with the US to end the US-Israeli war on Iran, the Islamic Republic’s state media reported. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

item.title: Israel's Ben-Gvir sees 'no innocent people in Gaza or even Europe': Journalist Gideon Levy
item.description: FRANCE 24's François Picard welcomes veteran Israeli journalist and Haaretz columnist Gideon Levy. He offers a scathing analysis of Israeli politics, the Gaza war, the unprecedented rise of xenophobic nationalism and Israel's growing dependence on the United States. Speaking from Tel Aviv amid mounting electoral tensions, Levy argues that "everything – war and peace, domestic politics, legislation – is now covered by the shadow of the upcoming elections".

item.title: Iran and U.S. Officials Signal Progress as Cease-Fire Hangs in Balance
item.description: As people across the Middle East braced for the possibility of renewed fighting, officials from both sides said there were signs that they were moving closer to an agreement.

item.title: What will Trump do next with Iran?
item.description: Three months since the start of its conflict with Iran, the Trump administration is oscillating between strike threats and diplomatic overtures. Neither path has yielded a clear resolution.

item.title: Israeli Strikes Pummel Lebanon, Killing Medics Amid Fragile Truce
item.description: Saturday’s strikes damaged a main hospital in the Lebanese city of Tyre, as funerals for paramedics killed a day earlier were held.

item.title: US embassy in Ukraine warns of 'potentially significant air attack' that could happen in next 24 hours
'Significant movement here in Washington': US and Iran report progress towards deal on ending war
item.description: FRANCE 24 correspondent Fraser Jackson speaks from Washington, DC on the reported progress in the talks on ending the US-Israeli war on Iran.

item.title: Iran, US and Pakistan report progress in talks on ending war
item.description: Washington, Tehran and mediator Islamabad all said on Saturday that progress had been made on ending the US-Israeli war on Iran, with a Pakistani security official saying that a memorandum of understanding was being "fine-tuned".

item.description: Anahita Motazed Rad, Associate Fellow at the London School of Economics, is our guest.
